ambiguities_or_notes: Recovery reconstruction: the pinned Russian source identity is preserved; the complete wording and one editorial footnote were checked against the official 90-volume edition because the audited Russian ZIP is not byte-mountable in this runtime.
The draft's a)–e) structure, internal numbering, abrupt shifts between generic person, oneself, you, and I, and manuscript bracket expansions are preserved rather than normalized.
образование is kept primarily as formation / forming oneself rather than being freely modernized as education or self-development, because the repetition carries Tolstoy's argument.
способность воспроизведения is rendered faculty of reproduction in its cognitive context; no sexual sense is introduced.
The deliberately severe бредом in the future-life section is retained as delirium rather than softened.
The Golden Rule sentence is translated directly without importing scriptural wording beyond what Tolstoy wrote.
The exact page-marker sequence 229, 230, 231, 232 is preserved; marker placement should be byte-rechecked when the audited Russian snapshot becomes mountable.
